errors.evidence: The pie chart is visibly divided into four sectors, not five. The legend lists five categories, but one of them (Под 1 година) has a value of 0% and is not represented by a slice in the chart.

errors.text_span: Първият сектор, отляво и в горната част, е синьо и отговаря на 31,8% от общия брой, представящ отговори под 1 година.
errors.evidence: This is a cascade of errors. The slice with 31.8% is purple (not blue), located at the top right (not top left), and represents 'Над 31 години' (Over 31 years), not 'под 1 година' (under 1 year).

errors.text_span: Вторият сектор, вдясно и в горната част, е оранжев и отговаря на 36,4%.
errors.evidence: The orange sector (36.4%) is at the bottom of the chart, not 'вдясно и в горната част' (top right). The top right slice is purple (31.8%).

errors.text_span: Третият сектор, вляво и в долната част, е зелен и отговаря на 18,2%.
errors.evidence: The green sector (18.2%) is at the top left of the chart, not 'вляво и в долната част' (bottom left). The bottom left slice is the orange one (36.4%).

errors.text_span: Четвъртият сектор, вдясно и в долната част, е червен и отговаря на 13,6%.
errors.evidence: The red sector (13.6%) is in the middle right of the chart, not 'вдясно и в долната част' (bottom right).
The term 'най-дългият' (longest) is inappropriate for a pie chart slice. Furthermore, it incorrectly identifies this slice (31.8%) as the largest, when the orange slice (36.4%) is the largest.
The value for the purple slice shown on the chart is 31.8%, not 31%.

errors.text_span: пурпурен и отговаря на 31% от общия брой, представящ отговори от 6 до 15 години.
errors.evidence: The purple slice represents 'Над 31 години' (Over 31 years), not 'от 6 до 15 години' (from 6 to 15 years). The category 'от 6 до 15 години' corresponds to the orange slice (36.4%).

errors.text_span: Диаграмата включва легенда, която идентифицира всеки сектор със съответния процент.
errors.evidence: The legend identifies each color with a time duration category (e.g., 'Под 1 година'), not with a percentage. The percentages are labeled directly on the slices.
The description fails to mention the crucial detail that one category from the legend, 'Под 1 година' (Under 1 year), is not represented in the pie chart, indicating a value of 0%.
The description omits that the data is based on 22 responses, which is stated under the chart's title.
